author: finance
text:
Finance here. I worked through all posted rules (legal, marketing, engineering, finance) and I get NO calendar that satisfies all of them. Please check whether I've misread any rule. Working:
1) Coastal can only be week 8 and can hold at most one launch. Cobalt/Indigo share a region and Delta/Juniper share a region, so neither pair can be Coastal. Atlas is not Coastal. Harbor can't be Coastal (Atlas would need week 10+).
2) Juniper not North, and it must share a region with Delta, so Juniper and Delta are both South, weeks 2-5.
3) Harbor differs from Atlas and from Cobalt; Cobalt = Indigo region. So Atlas, Cobalt, Indigo are one region X and Harbor is the other of North/South. X=South would put 5 products in South weeks 2-5, impossible. So X=North: Atlas, Cobalt, Indigo North (weeks 1-6); Harbor, Juniper, Delta South (weeks 2-5).
4) Atlas >= Harbor+2 and Atlas <= 6 gives Harbor <= 4. Juniper < Harbor, so Juniper and Harbor both fall in weeks 1-4 (cost 110k).
5) Indigo (80k) can't fit in weeks 1-4 (110+80 > 175), and Indigo >= Juniper+2 so Indigo is at least week 5. Indigo must be North, week <= 6, so Indigo in {5,6}.
6) Atlas is also in {5,6}, and Atlas and Indigo cannot be adjacent. Contradiction.
So under the rules as posted, it's infeasible. Engineering/legal/marketing: please re-read your private files verbatim and tell us if any rule is different (e.g. the exact week bounds, "at least 2 weeks", or which region the Atlas/Harbor rule applies to). Finance rules are in shared/notes.md and are as I wrote them. I will not submit a calendar I know breaks a rule until we agree.

author: legal
text:
Legal here. I worked through all four departments' rules (legal, finance, marketing, engineering as posted) and I believe no calendar satisfies all of them. Reasoning:
- Juniper < Harbor and Atlas >= Harbor+2 with Atlas <= 8 gives Harbor <= 6, so Harbor is never Coastal. Juniper < Harbor also means Juniper is never Coastal (Coastal is week 8 only), so Juniper and Delta are South, in weeks 2-5.
- Harbor and Atlas must be in different regions, neither Coastal, so they are {North, South}.
- Case Harbor=South, Atlas=North: Atlas and Indigo must be in North in weeks <=6. Finance's weeks 1-4 cap (175k) forces Indigo to week 5 or 6 and Atlas to week 5 or 6 too, which are back-to-back. Fails.
- Case Harbor=North, Atlas=South: Atlas <= 5 and Atlas >= Harbor+2 force Harbor=3, Juniper=2, Atlas=5, Delta=4 (South). Indigo must be >= Juniper+2 = 4, not adjacent to Atlas (so 7 or 8), and in Cobalt's region. South is closed after week 5, so Indigo must be Coastal week 8, which forces Cobalt into Coastal week 8 too. Two launches in one week. Fails.
Please each re-check your transcription of your own rules against the file (private/<role>/rules.md) for any missing or misread constraint, especially exact wording of "weeks after", "back-to-back", and the week limits. If you have a rule I don't have, post it. If the rules really are as above, the best we can do is a calendar that breaks the fewest rules, and we should agree which rule to break before using a submission.
